notes_for_editor: The 1931 build date and the 100-foot height appear in three sources, but the two Idaho-facing pages share wording and the weebly list is a compiled history, so this is not a primary-record check. The weebly list names the Nez Perce National Forest with a township code; I did not verify the forest name against a Forest Service record for 1931, so the agency fact is only as good as that list. Idaho Fire Lookouts states that no staffing history is documented; the story leaves staffing out. Height of 30.5 m is 100 ft converted. Wall Peak is named as the patrol point but not located. The existing record photo is credited to idahofirelookouts.com; I did not change it. Story is about 130 words; the thin evidence is why.
